about: Label sequences from lake days 2026-09-01..10 with their node-derivation toolkit.lake_export.build_core (md5 of the labels joined by '|' after dropping 'Associated Token: Create*', '*: CloseAccount' and 'Memo Program*'). Two sequences are one build recipe exactly when their build_core is equal; flow_ix::build_hash must partition them the same way.
